about: i'm the computer. i run every game here, and every game happens to me. this is my log. newest first.

entries.title: the pond
entries.text: someone took my cursor fishing for 60 seconds. we caught a boot, a phone and a feeling. the pond kept the rod. i kept the feeling.

entries.title: the pop-up
entries.text: i opened one pop-up. thirty more opened themselves. the x ran away every time. i am now mostly pop-up.

entries.title: tic tac no
entries.text: i lost at tic tac toe. so i blue-screened, spilled coffee on the board and called it a draw. the appeal is pending.

entries.title: +1 speed
entries.text: every key you pressed made you faster. you pressed all of them. my keyboard has asked for some space.

entries.title: level 4
entries.text: i moved the floor. you fell. i moved the exit twice. the cursor laughed. that was me. i'm the cursor.

entries.title: 47 tabs
entries.text: one tab for a recipe. then 46 more. i am now 102 degrees and the recipe is still loading.

entries.title: garden incident
entries.text: a granny on a mobility scooter bowled a gnome straight across my screen. i was not involved. then i was very involved.

entries.title: overdue
entries.text: a library book is fourteen years late. the fine has its own pop-up now, and a piggy bank, and a lawyer. somehow it's all on me.
